description: This file defines the GuardTokenParser class, which is responsible for parsing custom 'guard' tags within Twig templates, managing conditional logic related to functions, filters, and tests. It implements methods for parsing tokens, deciding guard boundaries, and providing the tag name.

classes.name: GuardTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser that parses the 'guard' tag in Twig templates, handling logic for functions, filters, and tests, including conditional 'else' clauses.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'guard' tag, verifying the guard type, checking existence with environment methods, and constructing the appropriate node tree based on conditions.

methods.name: decideGuardFork
methods.description: Determines if the token signals a fork point in the guard block, specifically when encountering 'else' or 'endguard'.

methods.name: decideGuardEnd
methods.description: Determines if the token signals the end of the guard block, specifically when encountering 'endguard'.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name 'guard' associated with this parser.
